curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When a desperate scheme to save a sister's life fails catastrophically, how far will the fallout drag everyone involved?
curatedMovie.description: A deaf man and his girlfriend take desperate action to fund his sister’s kidney transplant, setting off a rapidly worsening situation.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, tense, and fast-moving South Korean thriller built for locked-in solo viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Park Chan-wook crafts a fast, punishing thriller where good intentions collapse into an unrelenting cycle of retribution.
